test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
** The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

It is a matter / of immense honour / to receive a MBA degree / from here
solution:
The correct answer is: "**to receive a MBA degree**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase is "to
